method: Independent model linguistic cross-review of all eight exact proposed source senses, roles, aspect policies and English slots, with pinned raw replay and independent normalizer/renderer reproduction. Not source-membership-only approval or native-human certification.

baselineCoverage.definition: At least one sourced English meaning or reviewed grammatical reading; not every meaning, usage or possible grammatical interpretation. No morphology-only fallback, untranslated lemma or placeholder counts.

sourcePins.agidNotice: Separate permissive original AGID notices, not GPL because of containing directory.

approved.context: Explicit personal breathing reading: a person breathes noisily and forcefully. No promotion of the dog-yelp or bird-call senses to human subjects.
approved.notes: The selected source explicitly says a person breathes noisily. This is not human promotion of the separate animal yelp/call senses; breathe inflects as the only predicate head.

approved.context: Selected transitive causation: make something white, by giving it white color or spreading white things on it. Not the separate impersonal snow-falling/weather reading.
approved.notes: Exact transitive whitening causation licenses a human agent and contextual patient. Weather snow-falling remains separate and impersonally restricted.

approved.context: Selected slang transitive consumption of liquor, especially wine. Wine is an explicit source-given selected subset, not a bird making cries.
approved.notes: Selected slang liquor consumption explicitly includes wine; wine is a reviewed subset, not a bird metaphor. The source sense says transitive; broad header intransitive must be scoped as inventory or suppressed for this selected reading, while retaining raw audit metadata.

approved.context: Selected transitive causing someone to lose heart; human agent with contextual affected person. Not weather, freezing a liquid, or an unlicensed removal of pronominal SE.
approved.notes: Source explicitly gives causative discouragement of someone, not freezing weather or a reflexive become-discouraged reading. Bare transitive trailing ellipsis is a selected word-level predicate with contextual patient.

approved.context: Selected transitive attentive examination of a contextual patient. Not liquid penetrating a material, a vessel drawing water, or pronominal putting on a hat.
approved.notes: Attentive examination is explicitly a separate source sense. It authorizes no personal-liquid soaking, hat clitic or vessel-only expansion.

approved.context: Explicit source desire/longing reading, with a contextual desired object; not a sheep or deer bleating and no personification of that animal sense.
approved.notes: Source explicitly describes anxious desire/longing. Yearn is a valid human intransitive predicate with a contextual desired object; animal bleating restrictions remain unchanged.

approved.context: Selected causative transitive making liquid flow or letting it out. Human operator is licensed; liquid is the patient, unlike the separate intransitive liquid-emission reading.
approved.notes: Separate transitive source is making/letting liquid flow. Human operator and explicit generic liquid patient are supported; this does not promote the intransitive flowing-liquid sense.

approved.context: Use the familiar singular second-person pronoun tú, and its associated form of address, when addressing a person. Someone is the human addressee implicit in tratar de tú; no claim that tú-address inherently means disrespect or is exclusive to Mexico.
approved.notes: Address someone as tú preserves the familiar singular pronoun and human addressee without implying disrespect or Mexico exclusivity. Someone is an explicit generic grammatical addressee, not a concrete invented person.

guards: Approve only unchanged selected sense/frame/profile/context; no old animal/weather/SE restrictions are altered.
PIAR selected slang transitive meaning must not be displayed as intransitive merely because of a broader source header; retain original inventory in audit.
Existing explicit-form, unsupported-mood, clitic, spelling and subject guards remain mandatory.
No generic used-to paraphrase or state-past approval added.
143 candidate gap spellings are independently reproduced potential readings, not actual global-union additions before integration.
